Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Bahadur Maurya
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

Heard Sri Vijay Bahadur Maurya, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Azad Singh, learned
A.G.A. for the State.

2.  This is an application under Section 482 of CrPC preferred by the applicant for quashing notice dated 05.07.2024 issued by Superintendent of Police (Economic Offences Research Organization)
U.P. Kanpur Nagar u/s 160/91 Cr.P.C. in Case Crime No. 705 of 2018 u/s 467, 468, 171, 120B, 417 L.P.C., Police Station Bilhaur, District Kanpur Nagar and for seeking a direction to the investigating authorities not to take any coercive step against the applicant in pursuance of the notice dated 05.07.2024 in Case Crime No. 705 of 2018 u/s 467, 468, 171, 120B, 417 LP.C., Police Station Bilhaur,
District Kanpur Nagar, considering the fact that applicant is on bail in the above noted case crime.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that post-lodging of the FIR under Sections 120-B, 471, 468, 467, 420 IPC in FIR No. 0705, the applicant has been enlarged on bail in Crl. Misc.
Bail Application No. 40640 of 2021 on 08.09.2022.

sentences.text: Post-investigation, charge sheet has also been submitted on 15.06.2021.

Thereafter, now the notice has been issued to the applicant requiring the Sudama Bajpai vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 6 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79134007/
1 applicant to be present within a period of seven days.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that now the applicant would be harassed.
5. Learned A.G.A. on the other hand submits that once charge sheet has been submitted and cognizance has been taken, then the natural consequences would follow.
6. Considering the submissions so made across the Bar, this Court is of the opinion that no good ground is made out to interfere in the present proceeding.
